public_wire_requirement: Preserve the Saleor-visible ID scalar/interface and relay/global-ID behavior used by retained operations
internal_mapping: Single tested codec maps opaque typed IDs to native UUIDs; do not change database primary keys for imitation
owner_modules: shared GraphQL adapter; owning domain SPIs
affected_dashboard_surfaces: all retained entity lists/details and mutations
required_acceptance: encode/decode round trips; invalid type/tag/ID rejection; ownership-scope denial; no raw UUID leakage where global IDs are expected
decision_basis: D-SALEOR-FULL-001 §D4; existing platform UUID identity across REST/GraphQL
review_trigger: P1 compatibility primitive and every adopted entity route

public_wire_requirement: Preserve the Saleor scalar wire representation and scale/range semantics for retained operations
internal_mapping: Use exact decimal arithmetic and currency-aware conversion to/from platform minor-unit strings; never use binary float for authoritative amounts
affected_dashboard_surfaces: product prices; channel listings; checkout; discounts/taxes; orders; refunds
required_acceptance: currency exponent and rounding tests; overflow/negative/precision failures; price/tax snapshots; Dashboard round trip
decision_basis: D-SALEOR-FULL-001 §D4; platform exact minor-unit money contract

public_wire_requirement: For every retained upstream Dashboard mutation preserve Saleor payload/error fields, enums, nullability and per-field error semantics expected by the operation
internal_mapping: Map domain validation and authorization errors into the correct Saleor-shaped payload; platform-only operations may additionally use stable extensions.code
owner_modules: owning domain SPIs; shared GraphQL adapter
affected_dashboard_surfaces: all retained mutation forms and error states
required_acceptance: valid/invalid mutation snapshots; field-level errors; authorization denial; no false-success payloads
review_trigger: each mutation operation before route release

public_wire_requirement: Support the auth/session behavior required by retained Dashboard routes; any unused stock Saleor credential mutation needs a route-specific recorded disposition
internal_mapping: Use platform OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE and server-side RBAC/resource/provider/geographic scope; no parallel password database
owner_modules: identity; console; shared Dashboard auth adapter
affected_dashboard_surfaces: login/session expiry; staff and provider route guards; users and permissions
required_acceptance: PKCE; refresh/expiry; anonymous 401; CSRF/CORS; cross-role/provider denial; audit evidence
decision_basis: Existing OIDC/PKCE is the platform identity authority; D-SALEOR-FULL-001 §P1

public_wire_requirement: Keep Saleor operation/input/output shapes for retained Dashboard translation surfaces
internal_mapping: Translate supported EN/AR fields through owning domain services; reject unsupported languages explicitly unless the product model is extended
required_acceptance: locale round-trip; unsupported-language behavior; translated slug uniqueness; persisted read-back
decision_basis: Platform bilingual domain fields are existing design; scope for all Saleor translation surfaces must be ratified

public_wire_requirement: Preserve Saleor channel arguments and output shape for retained Dashboard operations
internal_mapping: Map to real publication, currency, pricing, tax, promotion, shipping and order-visibility context; a neighbourhood/persona/provider scope is not itself a channel
affected_dashboard_surfaces: product listings; channel listing editors; checkout/order contexts
required_acceptance: isolation across channels; price/currency/tax/discount parity; eligibility; cross-channel access denial
decision_basis: D-SALEOR-FULL-001 §P3; needs explicit product model/owner decision
review_trigger: before Channel or channel-dependent routes ship

public_wire_requirement: Preserve Saleor Order/OrderLine field semantics for retained Dashboard screens
internal_mapping: Adapt the platform aggregate order and seller-specific order/delivery legs without creating a second order state machine
required_acceptance: mixed-seller checkout; immutable price/fee snapshot; seller isolation; partial refund; replay/idempotency; ledger reconciliation
decision_basis: Existing platform owner modules and seller-split business model; D-SALEOR-FULL-001 §P4

public_wire_requirement: Retain Saleor Transaction/Payment contract expected by the selected Dashboard operations
internal_mapping: Map the compatibility facade to the existing PSP transaction and ledger owners; webhooks remain signed authoritative callbacks
affected_dashboard_surfaces: payment summary; transaction events; refund surfaces
required_acceptance: provider webhook replay; idempotent capture/refund; reconciliation; authorization; audit read-back
decision_basis: Single payment/ledger source of truth; D-SALEOR-FULL-001 §P4

public_wire_requirement: Expose Saleor-shaped product media mutation/result behavior to retained Dashboard editors
internal_mapping: Use the existing media/S3 owner with signed or supported upload flow; no fake or in-memory URLs
required_acceptance: upload/sign/complete/read-back; reorder/delete; file/type/size rejection; wrong-owner denial
review_trigger: before product editor media controls ship

public_wire_requirement: Do not return fake Saleor App/Plugin records; every retained operation must represent a real platform capability or be explicitly disabled/disposed
internal_mapping: Use a real platform extension registry and Modulith event/outbox delivery model; external partner delivery uses signatures/retries/audit
owner_modules: console; platform extension registry; Modulith events; integration owners
required_acceptance: install/configure/disable lifecycle only when supported; signed payload; retry/replay/idempotency; secret redaction
decision_basis: Platform does not run Saleor backend or Saleor Cloud app registry; D-SALEOR-FULL-001 §P5

public_wire_requirement: No active Dashboard route may depend on Federation unless gateway composition is explicitly adopted
internal_mapping: Standalone Spring GraphQL server; no resolver or fake federation metadata unless architecture changes
required_acceptance: static scan finds no retained Dashboard dependency; ADR documents standalone-server scope; release build removes/disables any dependent route
decision_basis: Current platform is a standalone server with no gateway composition
